# PePsic - Periódicos de Psicologia

> PePsic is Latin America's premier open-access repository of peer-reviewed psychology journals managed by leading Brazilian psychology organizations.

PePsic (Periódicos de Psicologia) serves as a central hub for psychology research across Latin America, providing free access to scientific articles and academic publications. The portal is managed collaboratively by the Conselho Federal de Psicologia (CFP), ANPEPP, and other major Brazilian psychology associations, integrated with the SciELO and BVSalud networks.

## Journal Portal & Repository

- [Periódicos de Psicologia - PePsic](https://pepsic.bvsalud.org/scielo.php): PePsic peer-reviewed psychology journal repository managed by CFP and ANPEPP, providing open-access to Latin American psychology research
